Alger, 9 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Le m: Algiers, August 9, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The Minister of Higher Education and Scientific Research, Mr. Kamal Badari, chaired the first coordination meeting dedicated to the deployment of the national strategic plan for artificial intelligence. The discussions helped define clear objectives to strengthen the country's technological sovereignty.
ALGER — La première réunion de coordinat: ALGIERS — The first coordination meeting, bringing together representatives from several ministries and national organizations, approved the definition of a joint action plan for artificial intelligence. This plan aims to accelerate the transition toward a modern and smart public administration, drawing inspiration from pioneering international experiences.
Les cinq axes prioritaires du document d: The five priority axes of the roadmap were finalized during this session. Developing sovereign and open-source artificial intelligence models tops the list of priorities, in order to guarantee the country's technological autonomy. The second objective consists of providing supercomputing capabilities, notably via national computing centers, to enable research centers and startups to train AI models locally.
Par ailleurs, le plan prévoit de renforc: In addition, the plan provides for strengthening human skills through intensive training programs in partnership with universities and research institutes. These initiatives specifically target data analysis and generative artificial intelligence. Another strategic component focuses on the creation of a dedicated research center and the deployment of specialized units to facilitate the transition from academic research to industrial application.
Enfin, le document insiste sur la sécuri: Finally, the document emphasizes the security of administrative and public data, with storage and processing ensured in secure national centers. Emphasis is placed on the ethics and reliability of the deployed technologies.
Un comité conjoint de suivi a été consti: A joint monitoring committee has been established to oversee the execution of the plan's stages according to a precise schedule. This committee will guarantee the concrete progress of the project and its alignment with the modernization objectives of the public administration.
